responsibility: Implements AArch64-specific FnAbi classification for returns and arguments, including AAPCS, Darwin PCS, and Win64 variants, by deciding when values are extended, passed as homogeneous float/vector aggregates, coerced into 64/128-bit register chunks, or lowered indirectly.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `asm/aarch64.rs`, this file does not define inline-assembly registers at all; it classifies function arguments and returns for AAPCS/Darwin/Win64 AArch64 ABIs, deciding extension, homogeneous aggregates, register chunking, and indirect passing.
